transcript: Speaker A: kya tumhare saath bhi hota hai? kaam tum karo, par credit kisi aur ko mile. [Does this happen to you too? You do the work, but someone else gets the credit.] mere saath teen saal yahi hua. wajah meri kaabiliyat nahi thi, wajah meri English thi. [This happened to me for three years. The reason wasn't my capability, it was my English.] teen saal se is office mein kaam kar rahi hoon, aur ek nayi ladki aayi, mujhse aadhe experience ki. [I've been working here for three years, and a new girl joined with half my experience.] par kuch hi mahinon mein har important meeting mein woh jaati hai, aur mein? mujhe bas report banane ka kaam mil jaata hai. [But in a few months, she goes to every important meeting, and I just get report work.] pehle laga naye logon ko mauka dete hain, par phir samajh aaya baat experience ki nahi, English ki thi. [At first I thought they give new people chances, but then I realized it was about English.] meeting mein mein bolne ki koshish karti - 'Sir, the work is... is done...' [In meetings I would try to speak - 'Sir, the work is... is done...'] aadhe log samajh nahi paate. aur wahi baat jab woh fluent English mein kehti, sab dhyaan se sunte. [Half the people couldn't understand. But when she said it in fluent English, everyone listened.] office mein saare log usse baat karte, lunch table par main akeli. [Everyone talked to her, while I was alone at the lunch table.] saari mehnat meri, par naam, izzat, mauka... sab uska. [All the hard work was mine, but the credit, respect, and opportunities were hers.] roommate ne kaha - 'main English Seekho app use karti hoon. tu woh try kar. ₹1 ka trial hai.' [My roommate suggested trying the English Seekho app, which has a 1 rupee trial.] maine us raat hi download kar liya. experts ke chhote-chhote lessons aur wahi sikhaate hain jo daily kaam aaye. [I downloaded it that night. It has short lessons by experts teaching daily-use English.] aur ek AI Coach hai - Disha. uske saath jab mann kare tab practice karo. [And there is an AI Coach, Disha, to practice with anytime.] maine roz 15 se 20 minutes ka routine bana liya. [I made a 15-20 minute daily routine.] phir ek din client meeting mein maine poora kaam khud present kiya, English mein, bina ruke. [Then in a client meeting, I presented everything in English without stopping.] meeting ke baad customer ne kaha - 'She knows her work really well.' [After the meeting, the customer praised my work.] boss ne bhi tareef ki. [The boss also praised me.] agar tum bhi kaabil ho, mehnati ho, par sirf English ki wajah se peeche reh rahi ho - toh English Seekho download karo. [If you are capable but lagging behind due to English, download English Seekho.]

summary: An animated office worker shares her struggle of losing credit and opportunities to a less experienced colleague due to poor English skills. She overcomes this by using the English Seekho app, which offers practical lessons and an AI coach for daily practice. The ad ends with her successfully presenting to a client and encouraging others to download the app.
